headline: the DISAGREEMENT between the two estimators; the 50/50 blend is printed underneath
estimator_1: possessions x points-per-possession: POSS = pace_h + pace_a - league_pace; PTS = (OffRtg * opp DefRtg / league OffRtg) * POSS / 100
estimator_2: score-based: spread from a least-squares power rating solved on official final margins (HCA pinned to the measured home-win rate); total from the teams' own scored and allowed rates
home_court: HCA is NOT fitted. It is the points equivalent of the measured home-win rate: sigma_margin * Phi^-1(home_win_rate).
